description: This file defines utilities for parsing, validating, decoding, and encoding JSON Lines (JSONL) messages related to an OpenClaw UI Canvas. It includes structures to represent parsed items and methods to process JSON messages, validate message types, and encode messages as JSON arrays.

classes.name: ParsedItem
classes.description: Represents a parsed JSONL message with line number and message content.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Splits the input text into lines, decodes each line as JSON into an AnyCodable, and returns an array of ParsedItem objects.

methods.name: validateV0_8
methods.description: Validates a list of ParsedItems to ensure they conform to a specific set of allowed message types and structure, throwing errors if invalid.

methods.name: decodeMessagesFromJSONL
methods.description: Parses and validates JSONL text, returning an array of message payloads (AnyCodable).

methods.name: encodeMessagesJSONArray
methods.description: Encodes an array of messages (AnyCodable) into a JSON array string.
